optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Embedded Software Engineer, Charging Station Firmware
professionalSummary: Seasoned firmware engineer with 14 OTA releases to a 3,200‑station fleet, consistently monitoring session success rates and managing field‑on‑call incidents. Proven track record of coordinating release waves with operations, rigorously testing on HIL rigs, and delivering comprehensive release notes with clear limitations and hand‑over conditions.
experienceHighlights: Released fourteen firmware versions OTA between 2022‑2025, each in coordinated rollout waves with the operations centre and documented in individual release tickets.
Monitored fleet dashboard post‑release to track charging session success rates and served as field on‑call, resolving a fleet‑wide connector firmware fault in October 2023.
Coordinated release wave schedules, explicitly recording responsibilities in release tickets to delineate checks between my team and the operations centre.
Conducted HIL rig testing for every firmware version, attaching detailed test records to release tickets.
Authored release notes for each version, detailing known limitations on legacy station models and hand‑over conditions for field technicians.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Release tickets for the last five firmware versions, including rig test records and wave plans.
Operations incident log entry for the October 2023 fleet‑wide fault.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples explicitly document OTA releases, post‑release monitoring, on‑call incident handling, coordinated rollout waves, HIL testing, and release note creation. No evidence is provided for any other responsibilities or skills beyond those listed.

role.roleTitle: Embedded Software Engineer, Charging Station Firmware

evidence.text: Released fourteen firmware versions over the air to the installed fleet of about 3,200 public charging stations between 2022 and 2025, each in rollout waves agreed with the operations centre and each under a release ticket in my name.
evidence.notes: Direct claim of OTA releases and monitoring

evidence.text: Watched the charging session success rate on the fleet dashboard after each release wave and held the field on-call for the station faults the operations centre raised; the fleet-wide fault of October 2023, when a connector firmware bug stopped sessions on one station model, was handled on my on-call shift and is recorded in the operations incident log.

Held the field on-call for the station faults the operations centre raised; the fleet-wide fault of October 2023, when a connector firmware bug stopped sessions on one station model, was handled on my on-call shift and is recorded in the operations incident log.

Recruiter screen: the candidate described the release waves, the on-call shift pattern and the October 2023 fault, naming the affected station model; the account agrees with the resume and the incident record.
Coordinated the rollout waves for each release with the operations centre, recording in the release ticket which checks were mine and which belonged to the operations centre's wave sign-off.
Tested each firmware version on the hardware-in-the-loop rig before release, with the rig test record attached to the release ticket.
Wrote the release notes for each version, listing the known limitations on the older station models and the hand-over conditions for the field technicians.
